query: SELECT ?object ?objectLabel ?type ?typeLabel ?parent ?parentLabel WHERE { { BIND(wd:Q525 AS ?object) BIND("Stern" AS ?type) BIND("Stern" AS ?typeLabel) } UNION { ?object wdt:P31 wd:Q634 . BIND("Planet" AS ?type) BIND("Planet" AS ?typeLabel) } UNION { ?object wdt:P31 wd:Q2199 . BIND("Zwergplanet" AS ?type) BIND("Zwergplanet" AS ?typeLabel) } UNION { ?object wdt:P397 ?parent . ?parent wdt:P31 ?parentType . FILTER(?parentType IN (wd:Q634, wd:Q2199)) BIND("Mond" AS ?type) BIND("Mond" AS ?typeLabel) } SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en,de" . } } LIMIT 100
